name: dogfood-kafka-event-pipeline
description: Dogfood app (v1.31-2) — a Kafka event pipeline that exercises 4 v1 patterns (idempotent producer with partition key + batch / consumer group with offset commit + rebalance callback / exactly-once transactional producer + read-committed consumer / DLQ with retry policy + poison message quarantine + DLQ topic subscribe) + 4 v2 axes (KIP-98 raw protocol producer id/epoch fencing + txn coordinator state machine / ISR + high-watermark advance / Redpanda Schema Registry evolution check / confluent-kafka + Schema Registry testcontainers probe) driven by @kiwa/streaming v0.3 in KIWA_MODE=mock and a confluent-kafka 3.7 testcontainers pair in KIWA_MODE=real (env-gated on KAFKA_KEY). Behavioural fidelity feeds @kiwa/quality-metrics 13-axis release gate + Playwright e2e for producer / consumer / txn / idempotent flows.

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa/streaming -F @kiwa/core -F @kiwa/quality-metrics build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
